title: Decline in confidence sobering
content:
31 March 2004

Decline in confidence sobering

  • Michael Cullen
Finance

Embargoed to 1am, 31 March

Finance Minister Michael Cullen said the latest National Bank Outlook showing a fall in confidence at both the general and the enterprise level was sobering but not surprising given the February floods,">Reserve Bank foreign exchange intervention and the coming budget which will contribute growth oriented policies and a mild fiscal stimulus,” Dr Cullen said.
